en.text: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. the earth be moved.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华作王；万民当战抖！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華作王；萬民當戰抖！

en.text: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

zhSimplified.text: 他们当称赞他大而可畏的名；

zhTraditional.text: 他們當稱讚他大而可畏的名；

en.text: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

zhSimplified.text: 王有能力，喜爱公平，坚立公正， 中施行公平和公义。

zhTraditional.text: 王有能力，喜愛公平，堅立公正， 中施行公平和公義。

en.text: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

zhSimplified.text: 你们当尊崇耶和华—我们的 神，

zhTraditional.text: 你們當尊崇耶和華－我們的上帝，

en.text: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.
He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

zhSimplified.text: 他在云柱中对他们说话；

zhTraditional.text: 他在雲柱中對他們說話；

en.text: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我们的 神啊，你应允他们；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我們的上帝啊，你應允他們；

en.text: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!

zhSimplified.text: 你们要尊崇耶和华—我们的 神，

zhTraditional.text: 你們要尊崇耶和華－我們的上帝，
